label: Gen 3 - premium selling (H1/H2) + intraday momentum (H3)

config.gates: Short premium: worst day, CVaR(95), max DD, Sortino, kill if P&L sign depends on skew. H2: CVaR95 and worst day must improve >= 25%. H3: t > 1.96 vs random-direction null after costs.
config.skewCalibration: put slope 0.10-0.31 per 1% OTM (real SPXW 0DTE, 2 days), call flat; sweep set to 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30
config.pendingCheck: VIX1D vs real ATM IV (10.9% on 11/13, 15.3% on 11/18) sets atmScale before H1 runs
config.events: 32 days: FOMC, CPI, NFP, PCE (TradingView calendar, shutdown-shifted dates included)

results.note: Diagnostic, not a gate result: even with uncorrected VIX1D (the assumption most favourable to H1) every book loses (H1 -2.4% to -2.9%, H2 -1.6% to -1.8%).

Net of costs: mean -4.12 pts per trade, t = -2.31 vs the random-direction null (needed t > +1.96). Before costs: -2.62 pts, t = -1.47. The reversed signal nets +1.12 pts, t = +0.63. No edge in either direction.

summary: All three pre-registered hypotheses fail. H1: the direction-free 0DTE SPX condor loses 12% in-sample (PF 0.41) at every skew assumption, and still loses (-2.6%) even on raw, uncorrected VIX1D. H2: filters cut CVaR(95) by only 6% (needed 25%). H3: MNQ last-half-hour momentum has no edge in either direction (t = -1.47 before costs). VIX1D was found to overstate real 0DTE ATM vol by ~17% (atmScale 0.83 from three days of real SPXW prices).
